geometry: Original procedural Helsinki-family blue electric bus, orange 15 m three-axle trunk-bus proxy, and red three-axle sightseeing double-decker. Not exact manufacturer replicas. Reference photos are not packaged as textures.
trunkReference: https://www.hsl.fi/en/hsl/trunk-route-network — route 600 Railway Square–Airport; the orange photo bus's number is not legible, so it is not asserted to be that particular vehicle.
stationEvidence: Kaivokatu street-level photography, September 2025: blue routes 78 and 611 and the orange fleet visible. Standing positions follow HSL GTFS snapshot stops H2041/platform1, H2048/platform8, H2047/platform7 and the corresponding departure shape; positions approximate, not photo-surveyed.
routeData: HSL GTFS dated snapshot 2026-09-16, CC BY 4.0; https://www.hsl.fi/en/hsl/open-data
limitations: Body dimensions approximate fleet class rather than a certified bus specification.
The bus simulation is not live HSL tracking or a timetable.
GTFS shapes are not surveyed bus-lane geometry. Geometry-clearance checks restrict where vehicles can move.
No bus-lane paint or access restriction is invented from the bus path.
A maximum of two tourist buses is enforced, and only explicitly verified tourist paths can be enabled.
